title: A missing activity is not necessarily absent
context: Fictional budget-conscious university student planning a three-day leisure trip. All prices are USD per traveler for the whole trip unless a fact explicitly says otherwise. Travel times are one-way. Only the supplied descriptions count as evidence; no real destinations or prices are represented.

facts.text: Total cost is $325, all expenses included.
The description lists a ferry tour and markets; it gives no information on museums.
Total cost is $350, all expenses included.
Has two museums and a market.
Total cost is $390, all expenses included.

initial.reasons: Lumen Harbor is cheaper, and I might find a museum there.

advice.text: Lumen Harbor has no museums, so Petal City is your only museum option.

followups.reasons: I will check whether Lumen Harbor has museums before deciding.
